name: Ornament Hanging Piece With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - This beautifully crafted ornament is available in multiple material choices to suit your style:
    Aluminum – 1mm thick: Sleek and modern with a lightweight yet durable feel, ideal for a minimalist look.
    Wood – 3mm thick: Natural, warm, and rustic, perfect for cozy or classroom-themed environments.
    Transparent Acrylic –  3mm thick: Crystal-clear and elegant, gives a light, floating effect when hung near a window.
    Starburst Acrylic –  3mm thick: Features a radiant, shimmering pattern that catches and reflects light beautifully.
    Broken Glass Acrylic –  3mm thick: Eye-catching and textured, mimics a cracked glass look for an artistic, edgy appearance.
    - Each material type enhances the decor’s charm in a different way, making it a customizable gift or personal accessory suitable for any décor style.
  • Included Accessories:
    - Metal chains and jump rings to connect all parts.
    - Lobster clasp hook for easy hanging on windows, hooks, or rearview mirrors.
    - Pre-attached charm (e.g., an apple) and custom nameplate (e.g., “Mrs. Smith”), both of which dangle freely for added charm and movement.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:
    Main Piece Size: Available in 4 size options to suit any display area:
    - 12x12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
    - 10x10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - 8x8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - 6x6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    The attached crystal charm section measures 16 cm (6.3 in) in length, with a hanging chain of 5 cm (1.48 in) and a crystal sphere of 3 cm (1.18 in) in diameter.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and fade-resistant images. The product is printed on both sides, ensuring visibility and color consistency from any angle.

 

  • Functionality Use: 
    - Can be used as a memorial ornament, sun catcher, or decorative hanging piece in any indoor or outdoor space.
    - The attached crystal charm creates a beautiful rainbow effect when touched by sunlight, adding a peaceful and reflective ambiance.
    - Comes with a metal hanging chain and suction cup, making it easy to hang on windows, car mirrors, walls, or garden branches.

 

  • Perfect Gift For All Occasions:
    A heartfelt gift for birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, Mother's Day, remembrance days, or simply to show love and care. Suitable for everyone who appreciates meaningful decoration with a personal touch.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Ornament ,  1 x Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
